title: The last time my family was replaced by technology
title_zh: 上一次我的家庭被技术取代

paragraphs.en: My great-great-grandfather thought he’d be replaced by technology too.
paragraphs.zh: 我的高祖父当年也以为自己会被技术取代。

paragraphs.en: He was a farrier in Mandres-en-Barrois, the small village in rural France where I grew up. Shoeing horses, repairing farmers’ carts. Then he saw a car drive through the next town over, or read an article about it in the paper. I can’t tell what exactly happened in his mind at that moment, but soon after, he became a mechanic, like every man in the family after him.
paragraphs.zh: 他是马ndlres-en-Barrois的一名马蹄铁匠，那是我长大的法国乡村小镇。 给马钉蹄铁，修理农民的马车。 后来，他看到一辆汽车驶过邻近的镇子，或者在报纸上读到了相关的文章。 我说不清那一刻他脑海中究竟发生了什么，但不久之后，他成了一名机械师，就像他之后的家族里每个男人一样。

sents.en: He was a farrier in Mandres-en-Barrois, the small village in rural France where I grew up.
sents.zh: 他是马ndlres-en-Barrois的一名马蹄铁匠，那是我长大的法国乡村小镇。

sents.en: Shoeing horses, repairing farmers’ carts.
sents.zh: 给马钉蹄铁，修理农民的马车。

sents.en: Then he saw a car drive through the next town over, or read an article about it in the paper.
sents.zh: 后来，他看到一辆汽车驶过邻近的镇子，或者在报纸上读到了相关的文章。

sents.en: I can’t tell what exactly happened in his mind at that moment, but soon after, he became a mechanic, like every man in the family after him.
sents.zh: 我说不清那一刻他脑海中究竟发生了什么，但不久之后，他成了一名机械师，就像他之后的家族里每个男人一样。

paragraphs.en: In the end, and maybe after a long stretch of grief at trading his horses for engine grease, he kept his purpose: helping people get around. He just changed the technology, going from horses to engines.
paragraphs.zh: 最终，也许在经历了为引擎机油而卖掉马匹的漫长悲伤之后，他坚持了自己的目标：帮助人们出行。 他只是更换了技术，从马匹换成了引擎。

sents.en: In the end, and maybe after a long stretch of grief at trading his horses for engine grease, he kept his purpose: helping people get around.
sents.zh: 最终，也许在经历了为引擎机油而卖掉马匹的漫长悲伤之后，他坚持了自己的目标：帮助人们出行。

sents.en: He just changed the technology, going from horses to engines.
sents.zh: 他只是更换了技术，从马匹换成了引擎。

paragraphs.en: I think about this a lot these days, surrounded as I am by so many developers who wake up every day wondering what’s going to become of them. I must say there is some comfort in knowing that someone in my family had the same doubts before me.
paragraphs.zh: 这些天我常常思考这个问题，因为我身边有太多开发者，他们每天醒来都在担心自己的未来会怎样。 我必须说，知道我的家族中有人在我之前也有过同样的疑虑，多少让我感到一些安慰。

sents.en: I think about this a lot these days, surrounded as I am by so many developers who wake up every day wondering what’s going to become of them.
sents.zh: 这些天我常常思考这个问题，因为我身边有太多开发者，他们每天醒来都在担心自己的未来会怎样。

sents.en: I must say there is some comfort in knowing that someone in my family had the same doubts before me.
sents.zh: 我必须说，知道我的家族中有人在我之前也有过同样的疑虑，多少让我感到一些安慰。

paragraphs.en: Because, yes, we love to say AI is the biggest revolution since the Industrial Revolution, and that we’re going through a transformation unlike anything we’ve seen before. But that overlooks the farmers who watched the tractor roll in, or the farrier who watched the car arrive. Back then, the revolution was often right next door, hitting your neighbour. They didn’t have X to doomscroll first thing in the morning (lucky them), but they too wondered what on earth they were going to do, imagining the worst.
paragraphs.zh: 因为，没错，我们总爱说人工智能是自工业革命以来最大的革命，说我们正经历着一场前所未有的变革。 但这种说法忽略了当年眼睁睁看着拖拉机开进来的农民，也忽略了眼睁睁看着汽车出现的马蹄铁匠。 在那个时代，革命往往就发生在隔壁，冲击着你的邻居。 他们没有 X 可以在清晨一睁眼就不停刷屏（他们真幸运），但他们同样不知所措，担心自己究竟该何去何从，想象着最坏的情况。

sents.en: Because, yes, we love to say AI is the biggest revolution since the Industrial Revolution, and that we’re going through a transformation unlike anything we’ve seen before.
sents.zh: 因为，没错，我们总爱说人工智能是自工业革命以来最大的革命，说我们正经历着一场前所未有的变革。

sents.en: But that overlooks the farmers who watched the tractor roll in, or the farrier who watched the car arrive.
sents.zh: 但这种说法忽略了当年眼睁睁看着拖拉机开进来的农民，也忽略了眼睁睁看着汽车出现的马蹄铁匠。

sents.en: Back then, the revolution was often right next door, hitting your neighbour.
sents.zh: 在那个时代，革命往往就发生在隔壁，冲击着你的邻居。

sents.en: They didn’t have X to doomscroll first thing in the morning (lucky them), but they too wondered what on earth they were going to do, imagining the worst.
sents.zh: 他们没有 X 可以在清晨一睁眼就不停刷屏（他们真幸运），但他们同样不知所措，担心自己究竟该何去何从，想象着最坏的情况。

paragraphs.en: A century later, the torments felt by my great-great-grandfather are forgotten. The garage feels like it has always been in the family. My father loved his job like few people I know, as if it had run in the family forever. We just kept doing what we had always done: helping people get around. Just as some families in the village still farm the same fields today, mine kept the same purpose.
paragraphs.zh: 一个世纪之后，我的曾祖父所遭受的痛苦已被遗忘。 这间车库让人感觉它仿佛一直属于这个家族。 我父亲热爱他的工作，其程度在我认识的人中少有人及，仿佛这份事业早已世代相传。 我们只是继续做着一直在做的事：帮助人们出行。 正如村里有些人家至今仍耕种着同样的田地，我们家族也始终坚守着同样的使命。

sents.en: A century later, the torments felt by my great-great-grandfather are forgotten.
sents.zh: 一个世纪之后，我的曾祖父所遭受的痛苦已被遗忘。

sents.en: The garage feels like it has always been in the family.
sents.zh: 这间车库让人感觉它仿佛一直属于这个家族。

sents.en: My father loved his job like few people I know, as if it had run in the family forever.
sents.zh: 我父亲热爱他的工作，其程度在我认识的人中少有人及，仿佛这份事业早已世代相传。

sents.en: We just kept doing what we had always done: helping people get around.
sents.zh: 我们只是继续做着一直在做的事：帮助人们出行。

sents.en: Just as some families in the village still farm the same fields today, mine kept the same purpose.
sents.zh: 正如村里有些人家至今仍耕种着同样的田地，我们家族也始终坚守着同样的使命。

paragraphs.en: Not every farrier became a mechanic, and I’d never have heard of the ones who didn’t. So I won’t pretend his story proves anything. But it makes me wonder: what if what we loved about this job was never only the code?
paragraphs.zh: 并非每个马蹄铁匠都转型成了机械师，而那些没有转型的人，我根本不会听说过。 所以我不会假装他的故事能证明什么。 但它让我不禁思考：如果我们热爱这份工作的原因从来不只是代码呢？

sents.en: Not every farrier became a mechanic, and I’d never have heard of the ones who didn’t.
sents.zh: 并非每个马蹄铁匠都转型成了机械师，而那些没有转型的人，我根本不会听说过。

sents.en: So I won’t pretend his story proves anything.
sents.zh: 所以我不会假装他的故事能证明什么。

sents.en: But it makes me wonder: what if what we loved about this job was never only the code?
sents.zh: 但它让我不禁思考：如果我们热爱这份工作的原因从来不只是代码呢？

paragraphs.en: Many of us, deep down, are driven more by the joy of making things, solving problems, and seeing people use what we built than by the act of coding itself. After all, many of us decided we wanted to be developers before learning to code, just to create video games or websites. The desire came before the code.
paragraphs.zh: 我们许多人内心深处，更多地是被创造事物、解决问题、看到人们使用我们构建的东西所带来的快乐所驱动，而不是编码行为本身。 毕竟，我们许多人在学会编程之前就决定要成为开发者，只是为了创造电子游戏或网站。 愿望先于代码而来。

sents.en: Many of us, deep down, are driven more by the joy of making things, solving problems, and seeing people use what we built than by the act of coding itself.
sents.zh: 我们许多人内心深处，更多地是被创造事物、解决问题、看到人们使用我们构建的东西所带来的快乐所驱动，而不是编码行为本身。

sents.en: After all, many of us decided we wanted to be developers before learning to code, just to create video games or websites.
sents.zh: 毕竟，我们许多人在学会编程之前就决定要成为开发者，只是为了创造电子游戏或网站。

sents.en: The desire came before the code.
sents.zh: 愿望先于代码而来。

paragraphs.en: Be willing to let go of the how to hold on to the why.
paragraphs.zh: 愿意放下“如何做”，紧紧抓住“为什么”。
